turns.question: What is the street address of the British Library in London?
turns.shown:
The British Library's address is:

**96 Euston Road, London, NW1 2DB, England [1]**

Many independent sources give this same address, including Art Fund [2] and Britain Express [3]. The site is the St Pancras building. It is on the north side of Euston Road, between Euston railway station and St Pancras railway station. [4]

This is the main London site. The library also has a branch in Boston Spa, West Yorkshire, so don't confuse the two. The address doesn't change often, but I took it from third-party pages and not from the library's own website. If you're making a special trip, check bl.uk for opening hours and any closures.

Sources
[1] British Library — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_Library
[2] British Library - Art Fund — https://www.artfund.org/explore/museums-and-galleries/british-library
[3] British Library - London Travel and tourism information — https://www.britainexpress.com/articles/Notebook/british_library.htm
[4] British Library — https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_Library (search result age: 168 days ago)
